T0574.title: MFA Fatigue
T0574.definition: A social-engineering tactic that repeatedly triggers MFA prompts until a user approves one by mistake.
T0574.description: MFA fatigue repeatedly triggers authentication prompts until the user approves one through annoyance or confusion. It usually assumes the password is already compromised. Controls should combine number matching, location hints, login context, prompt throttling, risky-login blocking, and user education.
T0574.usageExample: Assess MFA Fatigue related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
